name: AsoStyle Boutique
description: a fictional Lagos clothing retailer selling ready-to-wear and custom-tailored Nigerian fashion
location: Shop 4, Example Plaza, Lekki, Lagos (fictional address)

delivery.freeDeliveryRule: Free delivery within Lagos for orders of ₦100,000 or more.
delivery.notes: We do not deliver outside Nigeria.

payments: Debit card through the website checkout
Pay on delivery — Lagos only, for orders under ₦50,000
orderProcessing: Ready-to-wear orders confirmed before 12 noon are dispatched the same business day.
Custom-tailored orders take 7–10 business days before dispatch.

conditions: Items must be unworn, unwashed and have their tags attached.
Exchanges for a different size are allowed within the return window.
The customer pays return delivery unless the item arrived damaged or wrong.
returns.refunds: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected.
exclusions: Custom-tailored items cannot be returned or refunded.

contact.humanHours: A human agent replies during opening hours, Monday to Saturday.

escalation: Payment deducted but no order confirmation
Complaints or requests to speak to a person
limits: The assistant cannot check order status or tracking.
The assistant cannot process, approve or confirm refunds.
The assistant cannot see customer accounts or other customers' details.

faqs.a: Ready-to-wear comes in sizes S to XXL. Custom tailoring is available from your measurements.

faqs.q: Do you take aso-ebi group orders?
faqs.a: Yes. Group orders need a minimum of 6 pieces and get a 10% discount.

faqs.q: How should I care for the fabrics?
faqs.a: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Do not bleach.
